intended_object: An explicit numerical constant, 2^796 + 2^781, that appears as the implied constant in a weighted twentieth-moment bound for sums of the divisor counts of neighbouring integers. The bound is used in the library's formalization of Bourgain–Gamburd–Sarnak (BGS) on Markoff triples mod p. This reading comes from the docstring and from how the constant is used in WeightedNeighborDivisorBound.lean.
explanation: This definition just names one specific natural number, 2^796 + 2^781 = 2^781 · 32769. That number is the explicit constant the library's own proof produces for a moment bound of the form "… ≤ D · p^2". It is used only as that bound's constant inside the library, in the theorems around lines 101–158 of the same file and in WeightedCoarseSupportSurjectivity.lean. The literature has no standard object with this value: it is a byproduct of this particular proof, so it is an auxiliary proof device rather than a mathematical notion. Whether the value is 'right' only matters in the sense that the theorems using it compile, and they do.
